decision: App id is dashboard_links under AGPL-3.0-or-later
why: Store forbids Nextcloud in the name and wants SPDX AGPL for OCP apps

decision: Target Nextcloud 33 to 35 with max-version set
why: Live store XSD requires max-version. NC 32 is at EOL. Latest stable is 34. 35 is RC.

decision: Use IAPIWidgetV2 and IAppConfig. Do not fork External sites.
why: Marketplace explorer. Official external app has no dashboard widget. Optional reuse is a runtime IAppManager check.

decision: info.xml category is dashboard. Validate against the store XSD not the server copy.
why: Store and server XSDs disagree on licence enums. Official lint-info-xml.yml wget's the appstore XSD.

decision: Ship CHANGELOG.md plus CHANGELOG.en.md and two signatures
why: Store parses Keep a Changelog. User update notices need CHANGELOG.en.md since NC 29. Store wants archive SHA-512 plus occ integrity:sign-app.

decision: Own catalog in IAppConfig. Optional import only via External sites OCS v1.
why: Official external app has no widget, no OCC, no events, no tables. Sites are JSON keys sites and max_site. OCA\External is private.

decision: iframe means link to /apps/external/{id}/ or our own embed page. redirect means the external URL.
why: redirect is a nav href flag, not a server redirect. SiteController always iframes if you hit the route.

decision: Do not clone externalportal and do not write into the external sites key.
why: Marketplace allows only public OCP. info.xml cannot require another app. IAppManager plus capability external.v1 is the discover path.

decision: Widget getOrder stays in 10 to 100.
why: Dashboard docs reserve 0 to 9 for shipped apps. externalportal uses 0 against that rule.

decision: Register the widget only in IBootstrap. Leave load empty.
why: info.xml dashboard widgets are not applied by AppManager. RegisterWidgetEvent is gone since NC 29.

decision: Set namespace in info.xml. Widget id is dashboard_links. Order 20.
why: Without namespace, my_links becomes OCA\My_links. Widget ids are global. 0 to 9 are reserved.

decision: Web dashboard shows 7 items. More goes through TYPE_MORE. New tiles stay in Customize until enabled.
why: GET widget-items without limit defaults to 7. Enabling the app does not add the tile to the user layout.

decision: PHP 8.2 minimum for Nextcloud 33 to 35.
why: NC 33 and 34 need PHP 8.2 to 8.5. NC 35 needs 8.3 to 8.5. Intersection for 33 plus is 8.2 if we also ship 33.

decision: Copy external for Marketplace skeleton. Copy user_status for the widget. Copy recommendations for Unit tests.
why: external has no widget and almost no tests. recommendations ships default_enable which the store rejects.

decision: Admin UI is Vue 3 plus @nextcloud/vue 9 plus Vite 7. No dashboard JS.
why: IAPIWidgetV2 renders from OCS. Official small apps have no Jest. CSRF stays on mutating OCS.

decision: How explanation written. Architect arena starts.
why: Four explorers plus explainer agree on IAPIWidgetV2, own IAppConfig catalog, OCS-only external import, store XSD.

decision: Candidate 3 treats importance as three catalog lanes
why: Dragging between Featured Company and Reference is the importance change. Import merges by href into Company without demoting.

decision: Candidate 4 uses a content-hash revision and no client sort field
why: Replay of an identical catalog is 200. A stale create is 412. LinkPresenter owns every URL and subtitle.

decision: Candidate 1 is client-minted UUIDs, hash revision, no sort field, zero PHP import
why: CatalogStore has current and replace. /open/{id} serves both modes so bookmarks survive a mode change.

decision: Picked candidate-1 as base. Grafted presenter, split codecs, lane-keyed PUT
why: Judge and parent agreed. candidate-4 presentation is additive. candidate-4 store is not.

decision: Unit 1 verified by parent
why: composer test 10/10 22 assertions. xmllint store XSD ok. php -l clean. Catalog::parse lanes + hash revisions e4da948788ba / 014e5c5dc94f.

decision: Start unit 2 HTTP on CatalogStore
why: Widget pages OCS Icons. DESIGN: both open modes go through /open/{id}. PUT is lane envelope. CatalogStore remains the only writer.

decision: CI and docs fan out without touching lib
why: CHANGELOG pair, README, GitHub workflows. Vue waits on OCS envelope.

decision: CI and Marketplace docs verified by parent
why: Lane PUT in README. Changelogs identical. Four self-contained workflows. composer test still 10/10. lib/ untouched.

decision: Unit 2 HTTP verified by parent
why: composer test 25/25 56 assertions. cs:check clean. openUrl is /open/{id} for both modes. PUT is three lanes. CatalogTest still 10.

decision: Start unit 3 admin Vue on the OCS envelope
why: Vue 3 + @nextcloud/vue 9 + Vite 7. CSRF axios. Initial state catalog + externalSitesAvailable. No dashboard JS.

decision: Unit 3 Vue verified by parent
why: wireRow omits importance. addScript dashboard_links-admin. Vite-config 2 emits .mjs; NC 33 locator treats it as type=module. composer test 25/25. Maps excluded from store tarball.

decision: Exclude js/*.map from store tarball and git
why: Production source map is ~2 MB and is not needed at runtime.
